title: Certify paired-diagonal gauges for dyadic Borel words
head: 85ee884ad5955f656167bdd44ed05c0196b7f546
body:
An even denominator alone does not place a Borel word outside PR2613's rank obstruction. This package decides whether every applied matrix becomes 2-integral in one common analytic basis `B=diag(D,D)`, `D=diag(2^a_i)`, and emits an independently checked integer potential or negative cycle. The decision is complete only for this paired-diagonal class. General lattice FO, the existing rank functional and Bellman-Ford retain their predecessor credit.

The basis preserves `n_I`, scalar mixing, block-lower maps and each paid rational rank. A literal two-data/one-auxiliary word uses four genuinely dyadic rank-one calls and full-Borel maps, reaches its complete formal endpoint, and attains the existing rank-four floor after the certified gauge. Named source half-frame/commutator controls and an incompatible off-diagonal pair reject; separate controls show why unrelated H/D scalings or entrywise denominator clearing can invalidate the target/rank argument.

Native CPython 3.12.7 registered replay and four semantic/Git-free export groups pass; 3.14.5 optimized primary passes. Independent AI review used no candidate executable: it reconstructed the complete formal word and all 5 transformed matrices, authenticated sources, and brute-forced bounded normalized potentials on all 4,352 graph cases, agreeing with 2,022 feasible and 2,330 infeasible outcomes. The package's checker independently validates matrix-entry certificates, while a separate min-plus oracle tests the producer.

Only `research/paired-diagonal-borel-gauge/` is added. Source PR2613 is pinned at `ea9b811636934a4e5a4a81c1b292619ba6d9f2c9`, with exact retained proof/README/scope-control code and SHA256/Git blobs; no predecessor executable is imported. Credit Sagar Thakrar, eumemic/PR288, Swapnil Jain/P1 and the retained model lineage. New material prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

The round started from current main 0fdd7d82 under revision 4, then fetched and fast-forwarded to canonical `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9` after revision 5 appeared. The assigned card was retained, not rerolled. TASK/README record the five-point decision: narrow local analytic interface, then stop; no family expansion. Selected frontier is unchanged. Pre-submission main/source checks at 16:48 UTC are unchanged; complete 817-PR/1,279-Discussion snapshots plus targeted source/latest-30 REST checks bound overlap coverage.

This is an analytic lower-bound filter, not a free physical conjugation. The caller must separately supply complete model/endpoint/target premises. A negative cycle says only no paired-diagonal gauge; it implies neither a saving nor an obstruction to other lattices. Physical execution, routing, hosting, precision and all-size admission remain unknown. No new supplier, kappa, selected cold replay, human review or formal-kernel certification is claimed.

Replay: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-diagonal-borel-gauge`.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2613#issuecomment-6197084472
